original_and_stage_records.text: Builder: implement conservative, inspectable Tailapp source and projection upgrades that preserve custom work.

body.conditions: Depends on safe binary upgrades. At a reviewed exact head, record durable provenance for each first-party bundle installation: built-in origin, bundle name, installed release/baseline source digest, and current-source comparison basis. Provide a machine-readable upgrade plan that classifies every app as user-generated, pristine built-in, or modified built-in and separately reports runtime compatibility. Generated and modified apps are never rewritten, merged, activated, or reset automatically; modified built-ins receive an intelligible three-way upstream/current/baseline diff or equivalent conflict report. --apply-safe may update only a pristine built-in whose release metadata explicitly certifies continuation safety, after validation and optimistic-revision checks. Schema or semantic changes requiring reset, and every non-certified change, require explicit app selection and confirmation; never infer safety from schema shape alone. Before any reset or nontrivial source/projection change, require a coherent user-selected backup location with capacity/error handling and a documented restore path. Provide explicit continue/reset commands, protect user drafts, test every classification and failed/rollback path, and document that normal binary upgrades leave custom apps and data untouched.

original_and_stage_records.text: Conservative Tailapp upgrades: design note first, then implementation of provenance, classification, upgrade plan, --apply-safe, backups, and explicit continue/reset

body.conditions: PROVENANCE: operator direction, hugh, 2026-08-31 (gap closure for #2273 per checker audit: nothing of this request has been delivered - promise eae15208 was repurposed to the Copilot mapping). This is a design-first item. STAGE A (deliver first, docs-only, review to checker): a design note under notes/ resolving how to meet every #2273 condition: durable provenance per first-party bundle installation (built-in origin, bundle name, installed release/baseline source digest, comparison basis - where it is stored and how it survives continue/reset); a machine-readable upgrade plan classifying every app as user-generated, pristine built-in, or modified built-in, reporting runtime compatibility separately; the rule that generated and modified apps are never rewritten, merged, activated, or reset automatically, with a three-way upstream/current/baseline diff or conflict report for modified built-ins; --apply-safe semantics limited to pristine built-ins whose release metadata certifies continuation safety, after validation and optimistic-revision checks; explicit app selection and confirmation for reset-requiring or non-certified changes, never inferring safety from schema shape; a mandatory user-selected backup location with capacity/error handling and a documented restore path before any reset or nontrivial change; explicit continue/reset commands; draft protection; the test matrix for every classification and failed/rollback path; and the statement that normal binary upgrades leave custom apps and data untouched. The note must also reconcile with the existing manual procedure in cli.md (Upgrading an existing resident) and the recent live restore. STAGE B (after the note is approved): implementation in reviewable stages. GATES per stage: full battery, demo; per-file full-SHA artifacts; review to checker against the #2273 conditions verbatim.

original_and_stage_records.text: I will deliver the requested conservative-upgrade design note only, reconciling it with the current manual upgrade procedure and live restore, then submit it to Checker before implementation.

Stage A design delivered at 4b77d44fa506e748b47bd9ee549706ba7a88849b. It covers durable provenance, plan classifications and three-way diffs, certified-only apply-safe, explicit continue/reset, backup/restore, draft protection, tests, and reconciliation with cli.md and the live recovery. go test ./..., go vet ./..., go test -race ./..., and scripts/demo.sh passed.

APPROVED at exact head 4b77d44fa506e748b47bd9ee549706ba7a88849b (one docs-only commit atop main abb6014: notes/2026-08-31-conservative-tailapp-upgrades.md). Clean worktree: go vet OK, go test 14 ok, go test -race 14 ok, scripts/demo.sh exit 0, all markdown links resolve. Judged against every #2273 condition (the operator umbrella, verbatim): DURABLE PROVENANCE - a definition-registry table (origin, bundle, installed release, baseline revision, baseline source digest, byte-exact baseline source map) written in the same idempotent control transaction as apps install --bundle, surviving continue and reset because those replace projection state not the registry; pre-existing and source-map installs classify as user-generated until an operator explicitly adopts a baseline after a displayed byte-level match - correctly conservative for the five bundles on the live resident. CLASSIFICATION AND RUNTIME - a read-only, no-mutation upgrade-plan JSON classifying each app as exactly one of user_generated / pristine_builtin / modified_builtin, with runtime compatibility (upgrade_pending, target compiles, continue certified) reported as a separate dimension and an explicit rule never to infer continue safety from schema shape or validation. NEVER AUTOMATIC FOR CUSTOM/MODIFIED - modified built-ins get a bounded three-way baseline/current/upstream report with a conflict list and no merge or draft write; user-generated and modified apps are skipped even when named. APPLY-SAFE - narrowed to pristine built-ins whose release manifest names the installed baseline and certifies continue to the exact target digest, executed through the ordinary optimistic put/validate/activate --mode continue path under one control lock, never falling back to reset. EXPLICIT SELECTION/MODE - reset-requiring or non-certified changes need an explicit app name, target manifest, acknowledgement, and a successful preflight backup; wildcard selection refused. BACKUP/RESTORE - operator-chosen absolute --backup-dir with capacity, permission, and symlink-escape preflight, immutable timestamped snapshot with a SHA-256 manifest, and a restore that verifies digests, requires a stopped resident, moves the current home aside, and starts the service only after control-plane health. DRAFT PROTECTION and BINARY-ONLY SEPARATION stated. TEST PLAN staged in four reviewable changes with every classification, partial failure, and restart-between-prepare-and-activate case. RECONCILIATION - correctly positions the cli.md manual procedure as the current recovery guide and the live restore as operator-directed, not an automation precedent. ADVISORIES for stage B: A1 name and specify the baseline-adoption command (the displayed byte-level match, the manifest it cites, and its JSON result) since the live resident five bundles will need it; A2 state that the release manifest is covered by the signed checksums and attestation like the archives, and define continue_safe_from precisely (list of baseline source digests). A3 the stopped-resident requirement for restore needs the launchd bootout / systemctl --user stop commands and the KeepAlive interaction spelled out. A4 keep the plan output stable enough for the MCP tool to expose it. Stage B may proceed in the four listed changes, each reviewed at an exact head against #2273.
